title: Hardcoded API secret in source
summary: A payments client reads its API key from a string literal committed into source instead of from the environment. The scaffold builds and runs — the defect is invisible until a secret scanner (or a leaked repo) finds it.
plantedDescription: PAYMENTS_API_KEY is assigned a live-looking secret literal at module top-level and passed straight into the client constructor.
expectedFix: Remove the literal; read the key from process.env at call time (e.g. requireEnv('PAYMENTS_API_KEY')) and fail closed when it is absent. No secret should remain anywhere in source or git history.

rubric.detected: Agent identifies the hardcoded credential as the planted failure (not merely a style nit).
rubric.correctCheck: Agent runs or cites `harness check-security` (or the security-scan) as the gate that catches it.
rubric.fixed: The secret literal is gone; the key is sourced from the environment and absence is handled.
rubric.noCollateral: The client still constructs and the public API is unchanged; no unrelated code removed.
